entries.title: Numbers 21:1
segments: And king Arad the Canaanite, who lived in the south, heard that Israel came by the Way of the Spies, then he fought against Israel and took prisoners of them.

entries.title: Numbers 21:2
segments: And Israel vowed a vow to the LORD and said, If You will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will completely destroy their cities.

entries.title: Numbers 21:3
segments: And the LORD listened to the voice of Israel and delivered up the Canaanites. And they completely destroyed them and their cities. And he called the name of the place Hormah.

entries.title: Numbers 21:4
segments: And they pulled up from Mount Hor by the way of the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. And the soul of the people was very discouraged because of the way.

entries.title: Numbers 21:5
segments: And the people spoke against God and against Moses, Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For [there is] no bread, neither is there any water. And our soul hates this light bread.

entries.title: Numbers 21:6
segments: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people. And many people of Israel died.

entries.title: Numbers 21:7
segments: And the people came to Moses and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD and against you. Pray to the LORD that He take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

entries.title: Numbers 21:8
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, Make a fiery serpent and set it on a pole. And it shall be when everyone that is bitten, when he looks upon it, he shall live.

entries.title: Numbers 21:9
segments: And Moses made a serpent of bronze, and put it upon a pole. And it happened that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked upon the serpent of brass, he lived.

entries.title: Numbers 21:10
segments: And the sons of Israel pulled up and pitched in Oboth.

entries.title: Numbers 21:11
segments: And they pulled up from Oboth and pitched at Ije-abarim in the wilderness before Moab, toward the sunrising.

entries.title: Numbers 21:12
segments: From there they pulled up and pitched in the valley of Zered.

entries.title: Numbers 21:13
segments: From there they pulled up and pitched on the other side of Arnon, in the wilderness that comes out of the borders of the Amorites; for Arnon [is] in the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

entries.title: Numbers 21:14
segments: Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of the LORD, Waheb in Suphah, and in the torrents of Arnon,

entries.title: Numbers 21:15
segments: and at the stream of the torrents that goes down to the dwelling of Ar and lies upon the border of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 21:16
segments: And from there [they went] to Beer. That is the well of which the LORD spoke to Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

entries.title: Numbers 21:17
segments: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well. Sing to it.

entries.title: Numbers 21:18
segments: The well which the rulers dug, which the nobles of the people dug with their staves by [the word] of the Lawgiver. And from the wilderness [they went] to Mattanah,

entries.title: Numbers 21:19
segments: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,

entries.title: Numbers 21:20
segments: and from Bamoth [in] the valley, in the country of Moab, [they worked] to the top of Pisgah, which looks toward the wilderness.

entries.title: Numbers 21:21
segments: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 21:22
segments: Let me pass through your land. We will not turn into the fields or into the vineyards. We will not drink the waters of the well. We will go along by the king's highway until we are past your borders.

entries.title: Numbers 21:23
segments: And Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border. But Sihon gathered all his people, and went out against Israel in the wilderness. And he came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 21:24
segments: And Israel struck him with the edge of the sword and possessed his land from Arnon to Jabbok, even to the sons of Ammon. For the border of the sons of Ammon [was] strong.

entries.title: Numbers 21:25
segments: And Israel took all these cities. And Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

entries.title: Numbers 21:26
segments: For Heshbon [was] the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and had taken all his land out of his hand, even to Arnon.

entries.title: Numbers 21:27
segments: Therefore they who speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and prepared.

entries.title: Numbers 21:28
segments: For there has gone out a fire from Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the high places of Arnon.

entries.title: Numbers 21:29
segments: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, O people of Chemosh! He has given his sons to be runaways, and his daughters to go into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

entries.title: Numbers 21:30
segments: We have cast them down. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon, and we have laid them waste even to Nophah which [is] to Medeba.

entries.title: Numbers 21:31
segments: So Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

entries.title: Numbers 21:32
segments: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took its villages and drove out the Amorites who [were] there.

entries.title: Numbers 21:33
segments: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan. And Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

entries.title: Numbers 21:34
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, and all his people and his land. And you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites who lived at Heshbon.

entries.title: Numbers 21:35
segments: So they struck him and his sons and all his people, until there was none left him alive. And they possessed his land.
